stories.title: Quaest divulga última pesquisa de intenção de voto para governador do PR; veja números

en.title: Quaest releases final voting intention poll for Paraná governor; see numbers
en.summary: The Quaest poll shows Sergio Moro of the PL leading in Paraná with 37%, followed by Sandro Alex of the PSD and Requião Filho of the PDT, one day before the election. The survey has a margin of error of two percentage points.

en.summary: Over 158 million voters are eligible to cast ballots in Sunday's election to choose the president and representatives in 26 states and the Federal District for governor, senator, and federal and state deputy positions.
